Net loss and total assets never changed. The company reports a loss in every year 2021-2025 (FY2025 -34,022,472; H1 2026 -29,571,775); no EPS-bearing discontinued operations, interim IS headings say 'Continuing operations' only.

document_completeness.summary: Every one of the 18 files holds a balance sheet, income statement with OCI, equity statement and cash flow statement, seen on rendered pages. The inventory is wrong for: 9M 2022 (c664278a, scanned_unreadable, in fact a complete interim FS, BS p4, IS p5, CF p7), 9M 2025 (1d613e00, other_no_statements_found, fully scanned complete FS), H1 2026 (3821f7b0, other_no_statements_found, review report plus all statements on image pages 3-9), Q1 2022 (1316a388, 'partial', all statements on image pages 4-7), FY2023 and FY2024 (80406437, 4d8feb8c, 'partial': BS and part of the cash flow sit on image pages 8-12), FY2022 (215b1df5), H1 2025 (35a1ae89) and others with image-only statement pages. Period labels: all four annual files carry the publication year (FY2022 labelled 2023, FY2023 labelled 2024, FY2024 labelled 2025, FY2025 labelled 2026); the inventory therefore reports a false internal gap '2022|FY' and a false extra '2026|FY'. Interim labels are correct. No duplicates, no wrong-company files, no non-statement files. One printed typo: Q1 2022 financing subtotal is captioned 'investing'. Q1 2023 cover says 'three-month period' correctly; H1 2022 etc. fine.
